docs.title: Make clips from a YouTube, Twitch or Kick link
docs.answer: Copy the link to a stream or video, paste it on Home and tap **Make clips**. Clip Factory finds the best moments for you.
steps: Copy the link from YouTube, Twitch or Kick.
Watch it work in **Jobs**. New clips wait for you in **Review**.

docs.title: Make clips from your own video file
docs.answer: You can make clips from a video file too. Tap **Pick a video** on Home, choose the file and tap **Make clips**. On a computer you can also drag the video onto the box.
steps: Tap the box and pick an MP4, MOV or WebM file (up to 5 GB). On a computer you can also drag the video from your folder and drop it on the box.

docs.title: Where is my job and how long does it take
docs.answer: Every link or video you add is one job. **Jobs** shows each one being made, step by step.
steps: Tap a job to watch its steps.
To stop it, tap **Stop job**. Clips already made are kept.

docs.title: My job failed
docs.answer: When a job fails, open it and tap **Try again**. It starts over from the beginning and uses the video it already saved.

docs.title: Delete a job
docs.answer: Tap the bin on a job in **Jobs**, or tap **Delete job** on its page. Clip Factory asks first and says what happens. A job still working stops first. Clips you kept or posted stay, and your posts stay up. Its clips waiting in Review go too only if you turn on **Also delete its clips in Review**. You can undo for 8 seconds.
steps: Tap the bin on the job, or tap **Select** to pick several (**Pick all failed** picks every failed one).

docs.title: Is anything running right now
docs.answer: **Jobs** shows what Clip Factory is making right now.
steps: Tap **Jobs** to see each job and how far along it is.

docs.title: What Upload does
docs.answer: **Upload** says yes to a clip. It goes up to every place you picked under **Upload to**, each with its own caption. Nothing is posted until you tap **Upload**.
steps: Under **Upload to**, turn on each place you want.
Tap **Upload** to post it, or **Throw away** if you do not like it.

docs.title: Upload to many places at once
docs.answer: On each clip, **Upload to** shows every place that is set up, all ticked to start. Tap **Use my settings**, then **Upload**. That is the only place picker: each ticked place gets its own row below for its words and options. A place that is not set up yet does not show; set it up in **Set up posting**.
steps: Under **Upload to**, tap a place to untick it if it should not go there.

docs.where: Review › a clip › Use my settings
docs.title: Use my settings: upload in two taps
docs.answer: **Use my settings** puts your saved choices on every ticked place: who can see it, comments, duets and stitches, never made for kids. TikTok needs your own tap each time, so tap it, then tap **Upload**. Change a place for one clip in its row.
steps: Tap **Use my settings**. It says **Your settings are on**.

docs.where: Review › a clip › a place's row
docs.title: Change one place for one clip
docs.answer: Each ticked place has its own row under **Use my settings**. Tap the row to open its words and options. For a paid partnership, open **TikTok**, turn on **Commercial content** and tick **Branded content**.
steps: Tap a place's row, like **TikTok · caption and settings**.
Change what you want, then tap **Upload**.

docs.title: Change My settings
docs.answer: **My settings** are the choices **Use my settings** puts on a clip, one part per place, X too. They start at everyone can see it, comments, duets and stitches on, and never made for kids.
steps: Change a place. It saves at once.

docs.title: Throw away a clip, and Undo
docs.answer: Tap **Throw away** on a clip you do not want. Changed your mind? Tap **Undo** within 8 seconds and it comes back.
steps: Oops? Tap **Undo** on the message at the bottom, within 8 seconds.

docs.title: Change a caption before Upload
docs.answer: Each clip has its own caption for every place it goes. Change them on the clip in **Review** before you tap **Upload**. They save by themselves.
steps: Tap the place's row, like **TikTok · caption and settings**.

docs.title: What Chat went wild means
docs.answer: Each clip card says **Why:** it was picked. **Chat went wild** means the stream's chat suddenly went much faster than usual, or lots of people typed the same thing, right after this moment. Clip Factory only trusts it when something is also seen or heard there.
steps: **Chat went wild** means the viewers loved this moment.

docs.title: How many clips are waiting in Review
docs.answer: New clips wait in **Review** until you **Upload** or **Throw away** each one.
steps: Tap **Review** to check them one by one.

docs.title: Uploading a clip did not work
docs.answer: If one place did not work, the clip in **Library** says **Didn't work** with the reason, and that place has its own **Try again**.
steps: Find the place that says **Didn't work**.

docs.title: See how a clip is doing
docs.answer: Open a clip in **Library** to see its views, likes and comments on each place it was posted. A crown marks where it did best.
steps: Scroll to see each place and its numbers.

docs.title: How much money did I make?
keywords: how much money did i make
docs.answer: Clip Factory only shows money an app reports. It never guesses from views and you never type money in. Tap **Money** in the menu. The big number at the top is what the apps reported for your last 30 days. The list under it shows each posted clip with what YouTube says it earned, the biggest first. TikTok, Instagram and X don't share money with apps.
steps: Read the big number at the top. Each amount says whose estimate it is.
Scroll down to see what each clip earned.

docs.title: What is MRR on the Money page?
docs.answer: MRR usually means subscriptions. Here it means the money the apps reported for your videos: **Monthly MRR** is the last 30 days, **Weekly MRR** the last 7, **Daily MRR** a normal day lately and **Yearly MRR** the monthly money kept up for a year (**at this pace**). Pick apps with the icons at the bottom right.
steps: Tap app icons in the bar at the bottom right to pick apps. **All** shows every app.
Tap **7 days**, **30 days**, **90 days** or **Year** to change the chart and the clip list.

docs.title: Am I monetized yet?
docs.answer: Open **Settings › Posting › Money**. Each app's card has a pill: **Earning**, **In the program**, **Not yet**, **Goal reached**, **Can't tell** or **Not shared**, and bars like 812 / 1,000 subscribers. Only YouTube tells apps if you're in its paid program. **Goal reached** means you hit the numbers, but the app also checks things Clip Factory can't see.
steps: Look at each app's pill and bars.
Tap **More** to see the other goals.

docs.title: Let Clip Factory read your YouTube money
docs.answer: On the YouTube card, press **Allow money reading** and say yes on Google's page. A grown-up first adds the money permission in the same Google Cloud project (no new keys) and sets Publishing status to **In production**. Google's "unverified app" screen is normal: press **Advanced**, then **Continue**. Your connection and posts stay as they are.
steps: On the YouTube card, tap **First time? Steps for a grown-up** and do the steps.

docs.where: Settings › Posting › Money › Getting your money out
docs.title: Where do I add my bank account to get paid?
docs.answer: Each app pays you itself, so you add your bank account or PayPal inside each app. YouTube: **AdSense for YouTube › Payments**. Facebook and Instagram: Meta's payout settings. TikTok: your TikTok **Balance**. X: **Monetization**, through Stripe. Clip Factory never needs your bank details, and never asks for them.
steps: Open that app and add your bank or PayPal there.

docs.title: How many views does this clip have
docs.answer: A clip's page in **Library** adds up its views from every place it was posted.
steps: Tap the clip to see its views.

live.text: This clip has {value} views so far. It does best on {platform}.

docs.title: How many clips have I posted
docs.answer: **Library** lists every clip you uploaded.

docs.title: Refresh numbers
docs.answer: Numbers update by themselves. To check now, open the clip and tap **Refresh numbers**. If it says **Next check in**, wait that long. Instagram and Facebook can take 2 days to settle.

docs.title: Star the best clips of the week
docs.answer: In **Library**, tap **This week** and star the clips that did best with **Best this week**. Clip Factory learns from your stars and makes more clips like them.
steps: Tap the star on your best clips (up to 10).

docs.where: Settings › Clip making › What it learned
docs.title: How Clip Factory learns from your clips
docs.answer: Every day Clip Factory checks your clips 7 days after posting. When some clips did much better than normal for that streamer, it looks at what they share and writes a short lesson. Lessons it is sure about go to your skills as **Prior learnings**. You can turn a lesson off or delete it in **What it learned**.
steps: Tap **Turn off** or **Delete** on a lesson you do not like.

docs.where: Settings › Clip making › Streamers I follow
docs.title: Follow streamers and see who is live
docs.answer: Open **Streamers I follow** and paste a streamer's link or type their name. If you type a name, tap **YouTube**, **Twitch** or **Kick**. Only follow streamers who said you can clip them: tap **Yes, they said I can**, then **Follow**. You see who is **LIVE** and when a stream ended or a new video came out. Making clips by itself comes in the next update; each video costs the same as one you paste.
steps: Paste a link or type a name, then tap **Find**.
Tap **Yes, they said I can**, then **Follow**.

docs.where: Settings › Clip making › Streamers I follow › Twitch and Kick keys
docs.title: Twitch and Kick keys for live badges
docs.answer: YouTube works without keys. To see when Twitch or Kick streamers are live, a grown-up makes a free app on dev.twitch.tv or kick.com once and pastes its two keys in **Twitch and Kick keys**. Until then the streamer shows **Needs a grown-up**, but you can still follow them. Removing keys needs a long press.
steps: Ask a grown-up to tap **I am the grown-up** and follow the steps.

docs.title: Views on my best clip this week
docs.answer: **This week** in **Library** shows this week's clips, most views first.

live.text: Your best clip this week, "{hook}", has {value} views.

docs.title: Total views this week
docs.answer: **This week** in **Library** adds up the views of this week's clips.

live.text: This week's clips have {value} views together.

docs.title: How many clips this week
docs.answer: **This week** in **Library** lists the clips from this week.

docs.where: Settings › Posting › Set up posting › TikTok
docs.title: Why my clip is private on TikTok
docs.answer: TikTok shows posts from Clip Factory privately until Clip Factory's TikTok app is approved. Your clip is posted, only you can see it for now, and its numbers come after.
steps: TikTok says **Uploaded privately**. That is normal for now.

docs.where: Settings › Posting › Set up posting › TikTok
docs.title: TikTok won't let me press Save
docs.answer: On TikTok's app page, **Save** stays off until **App review** has its text and a video. Copy the review text in TikTok setup step 13, add a short screen video, then Save. Display API is not a product any more: add video.list and user.info.stats with **Add scopes** under Login Kit.
steps: Copy the review text into **App review**.

docs.where: Settings › Posting › Set up posting › YouTube
docs.title: Connect YouTube
docs.answer: Open **Set up posting** and tap **YouTube**. Follow its steps one by one: make your key, paste it, then tap **Connect YouTube**. You do it once, then Clip Factory posts there by itself.

docs.where: Settings › Posting › Set up posting › Instagram
docs.title: Connect Instagram
docs.answer: Open **Set up posting** and tap **Instagram**. Follow its steps one by one: make your key, paste it, then tap **Connect Instagram**. You do it once, then Clip Factory posts there by itself.

docs.where: Settings › Posting › Set up posting › Facebook
docs.title: Connect Facebook
docs.answer: Open **Set up posting** and tap **Facebook**. Follow its steps one by one: make your key, paste it, then tap **Connect Facebook**. You do it once, then Clip Factory posts there by itself.

docs.where: Settings › Posting › Set up posting › TikTok
docs.title: Connect TikTok
docs.answer: Open **Set up posting** and tap **TikTok**. Follow its steps one by one: make your key, paste it, then tap **Connect TikTok**. You do it once, then Clip Factory posts there by itself.

docs.where: Settings › Posting › Set up posting › X
docs.title: Connect X
docs.answer: Open **Set up posting** and tap **X**. Follow its steps one by one: make your key, paste it, then tap **Connect X**. You do it once, then Clip Factory posts there by itself.

docs.title: Which accounts are connected
docs.answer: **Set up posting** shows how many of the five places are ready, and a card for each one.

docs.title: Where did my setup list go?
docs.answer: The **Set up posting** list sits at the top right until each place is set up or skipped. When all five are done or skipped, it says **All set!** and goes away. It comes back by itself if a place you set up needs you again. You can always find every place, skip one, or bring back one you skipped in **Settings › Posting › Set up posting**.
steps: Find the place you skipped. It says **Skipped**.
Tap **Un-skip** to put it back on the list, or tap its card to set it up now.

docs.title: Which places start switched on
docs.answer: In **Where clips go** you pick the places that start switched on for new clips. On each clip you can still turn places on or off under **Upload to**.
steps: Turn each place on or off.

docs.where: Settings › Posting › Set up posting › X
docs.title: What X charges for numbers
docs.answer: X charges a little for every number check. The checks stop at $10 a month, so X never costs more.

docs.title: Add a skill
docs.answer: In Skills, tap **Write a skill** and answer three easy questions. Or tap **Upload a file** to add a SKILL.md or a .zip with one inside.
steps: Tap **Write a skill**, or **Upload a file**.

docs.title: What a skill is
docs.answer: A skill teaches Clip Factory how you like your clips. All the AI in Clip Factory uses every skill, every time. To stop using one, open it and tap **Delete**. Built-in skills stay.
steps: Tap a skill to read it, edit it or delete it.

live.text: Skills Clip Factory uses right now: {value}.

docs.where: Settings › Clip making › Skills › Write a skill
docs.title: Make your own skill
docs.answer: Tap **Write a skill**. Answer the three questions: a name, when to use it, and what Clip Factory should do. Tap **Use the example** if you are stuck. Then tap **Save skill**.

docs.title: Edit a skill
docs.answer: Open **Skills** and tap the skill. Tap **Edit**, change the words, then tap **Save changes**. Built-in skills can be read, not changed.

docs.title: Delete a skill
docs.answer: To throw away a skill, open **Skills** and tap the skill. Tap **Delete**, then **Delete** again. Changed your mind? Tap **Undo** at the bottom. Built-in skills cannot be deleted.

docs.title: Change the click sound
docs.answer: Pick your **Click sound** in Settings › Look & feel › Sounds. There are 30 to choose from. Tap a card to hear it.
steps: Under **Click sound**, tap a card to hear it and pick it.

docs.title: Change the error sound
docs.answer: Pick your **Error sound** in Settings › Look & feel › Sounds. There are 30 to choose from. Tap a card to hear it.
steps: Under **Error sound**, tap a card to hear it and pick it.

docs.title: Turn sounds off or on
docs.answer: Use the **Sounds** switch in Settings › Look & feel › Sounds to turn every sound off or on.

docs.title: Make it calmer: Reduce motion and Background
docs.answer: Turn on **Reduce motion** to stop confetti, page moves and the moving background. In **Background** you can pick plain **Colours** instead of the glass or a picture.

docs.title: See through the app, or pick a picture or colours
docs.answer: In **Background** pick **See-through**, **Picture** or **Colours**. See-through lets what is behind the window peek through the glass in the Mac and Windows app. Browsers and phones can't look behind the app, so there you get the Clip Factory colours.

docs.where: Settings › App & account › Get the app
docs.title: Get the app for your computer
docs.answer: You can put Clip Factory on your computer like any other app. Open **Get the app** and tap the download button for your computer.
steps: Tap **Download for Mac** or **Download for Windows**.
If your Mac says it can't open it: System Settings, Privacy & Security, Open Anyway.

docs.where: Settings › App & account › Get the app
docs.title: Add Clip Factory to your iPhone Home Screen
docs.answer: On iPhone and iPad, Clip Factory goes on your Home Screen from Safari.

docs.where: Settings › App & account › Get the app
docs.title: Install Clip Factory on Android
docs.answer: On Android, your browser can install Clip Factory like any other app.
steps: Tap **Install app**. Some phones say **Add to Home screen**.

docs.title: Update the app
docs.answer: New versions arrive by themselves. When one is ready, a bar at the bottom says **New version ready**. Tap **Reload**.
steps: Wait for the **New version ready** bar, then tap **Reload**.
To look right now: tap **Settings**, **App & account**, **Updates**.

docs.title: When YouTube blocks a video
docs.answer: Sometimes YouTube blocks a video and asks to sign in. Then add your **YouTube cookies** in YouTube help and tap **Try again** on the job. You can skip this until it happens.
steps: Tap **Add cookies.txt** and pick the file.
Go to **Jobs** and tap **Try again** on the blocked job.

docs.title: How many clips each time, and the longest video
docs.answer: In **Clips** you set the fewest and most clips Clip Factory makes each time, and the **Longest video** it uses.
steps: Change **How many clips** with the buttons.

docs.title: Sign out
docs.answer: Tap **Sign out** in Settings › App & account › Account.

docs.title: Show Ask a picture
docs.answer: Ask can look at a picture of your screen. Take a screenshot, then paste it in Ask or drop it on Ask.
steps: Press **Cmd+Ctrl+Shift+4** and drag over the part of the screen you want.
Or drag a picture onto **Ask**, or tap **Add a picture**.

docs.title: Show Ask a picture
docs.answer: Ask can look at a picture of your screen. Take a screenshot, then paste it in Ask.
steps: Press **Win+Shift+S** and drag over the part of the screen you want.
Or drag a picture onto **Ask**, or tap **Add a picture**.

docs.title: Show Ask a picture
docs.answer: Ask can look at a picture of your screen, or a photo.
steps: Press the side button and the volume up button together to take a screenshot.
Pick your screenshot, or take a photo.

docs.title: What Clip Factory is
docs.answer: Clip Factory turns your long streams and videos into short clips. You check each clip, tap **Upload**, and it posts them for you.
steps: Paste a link on **Home** and tap **Make clips**.

docs.title: Find my clips and videos in Library
docs.answer: Every clip you uploaded is in **Library**. New clips you have not checked yet wait in **Review**.
steps: Tap a clip to see how it does.

docs.where: Settings › App & account › Get the app
docs.title: Get the app on this computer
docs.answer: Your browser can put Clip Factory on this computer like any other app. Open **Get the app** and follow its steps.
steps: Follow the steps it shows for your browser.

docs.title: Turn on web search for Ask
docs.answer: Ask can read today's web pages once you add a free search key. Get it from Brave Search, paste it in **Settings › App & account › Ask** and tap **Save key**.
steps: Tap **Get a search key** and make a free account. Pick the **Search** plan.
Paste it under **Your search key** and tap **Save key**. A green check says web search is on.

docs.title: What Ask can do
docs.answer: Ask answers any question, not only about Clip Factory. It knows every page and setting, sees your own setup, can search the web and reads the files you add.
steps: Type any question, or add a file with the paperclip.
Tap the paper plane. The answer appears as it is written. Tap **Stop answer** to end it.

docs.title: Add files to Ask
docs.answer: Add files with the paperclip, drop them on Ask, or paste them. Ask reads pictures, PDFs, text files and Word, Excel and PowerPoint files. It never keeps them.
steps: Tap the paperclip, or drag files onto Ask, or paste them.
Each file shows as a tile with its kind and name.
Ask your question and tap the paper plane.

docs.title: Mark a picture in red
docs.answer: Tap a picture in Ask's tray to mark it. Draw with **Pen**, **Box** or **Arrow** in red, then tap **Save**. Ask sees exactly what you marked.
steps: Pick **Pen**, **Box** or **Arrow** and draw on what you mean.

docs.title: Home
docs.answer: Paste a link to a stream or a video. Clip Factory finds the best moments and makes short clips. You pick the ones to upload.

docs.title: Jobs
docs.answer: Every link or video you add is one job. Tap one to watch it being made, step by step.

docs.title: A job's page
docs.answer: A job's page shows each step as your clips are made. Tap a job in Jobs to open it.

docs.title: Review
docs.answer: These clips all come from one job. Tap Upload to post one, or Throw away if you do not like it. Tap Show every job to see the rest.

docs.title: Library
docs.answer: Library has every clip you uploaded.

docs.title: A clip's numbers
docs.answer: A clip's page shows how it does on each app. Tap a clip in Library to open it.

docs.title: Get the app
docs.answer: Get the app puts Clip Factory on this device, next to your other apps.

docs.title: Settings
docs.answer: Settings has Clip making, Posting, Look & feel, App & account. Type in **Find a setting** to jump to one.
steps: Type what you want in **Find a setting**.

docs.title: Clip making
docs.answer: How your clips are made. It has Clips, Skills, What it learned, Streamers I follow, YouTube help.

docs.title: Clips
docs.answer: How many clips, how long a video can be, and which AI makes them.

docs.title: How many clips
docs.answer: Clip Factory makes between your fewest and most clips each time.

docs.title: Longest video
docs.answer: For a longer video, only the first part is used.

docs.title: AI model
docs.answer: The AI that finds your moments and writes your captions. Your pick is used for your next clips.

docs.title: Skills
docs.answer: Teach Clip Factory how you like your clips.

docs.title: Your skills
docs.answer: Clip Factory uses every skill here, every time it makes or checks anything.

docs.title: Add a skill
docs.answer: Write one by answering three easy questions, or upload a skill file from your computer.

docs.where: Settings › Clip making › What it learned
docs.title: What it learned
docs.answer: Lessons from your clips that did best.

docs.where: Settings › Clip making › What it learned
docs.title: What it learned
docs.answer: Lessons from clips that did much better than normal. Turn one off or delete it.

docs.where: Settings › Clip making › Streamers I follow
docs.title: Streamers I follow
docs.answer: Follow YouTube, Twitch and Kick streamers and see who is live.

docs.where: Settings › Clip making › Streamers I follow
docs.title: Follow a streamer
docs.answer: Paste their link or type their name. Only follow streamers who said you can make clips.

docs.where: Settings › Clip making › Streamers I follow
docs.title: Who you follow
docs.answer: Who is live right now, and when a stream ended or a new video came out.

docs.where: Settings › Clip making › Streamers I follow
docs.title: Clips by itself
docs.answer: Each video it makes costs the same as one you paste. Coming in the next update.

docs.where: Settings › Clip making › Streamers I follow
docs.title: Twitch and Kick keys
docs.answer: A grown-up does this once. YouTube works without it.

docs.title: YouTube help
docs.answer: For when YouTube blocks a video.

docs.title: YouTube cookies
docs.answer: You can skip this. Add them only if YouTube blocks a video. Export them from a private window, then close it.

docs.title: Posting
docs.answer: Where your clips go. It has Set up posting, Where clips go, My settings, Money.

docs.title: Set up posting
keywords: The setup list on your screen
Who can see your YouTube clips
docs.answer: Connect YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook and X.

docs.title: Set up posting
docs.answer: Do each one once. After that Clip Factory posts by itself.

docs.title: The setup list on your screen
docs.answer: It stays at the top right until each place is set up or skipped. Skipped ones wait here.
steps: Find **The setup list on your screen**.

docs.title: Who can see your YouTube clips
docs.answer: Everyone, only people with the link, or only you.
steps: Find **Who can see your YouTube clips**.

docs.title: What X costs
docs.answer: About 1.5 cents a post. It stops at $10 a month.

docs.title: Where clips go
docs.answer: Pick the places your clips go.

docs.title: Upload clips to
docs.answer: Pick at least one place.

docs.title: My settings
docs.answer: How each clip goes up: public, open for comments, never made for kids.

docs.title: YouTube
docs.answer: Everyone can see it, Gaming, tells your subscribers. Never made for kids.

docs.title: TikTok
docs.answer: Everyone can see it; comments, Duet and Stitch on. You still tap Use my settings on each clip.

docs.title: Instagram
docs.answer: Reels also show in your feed.

docs.title: Facebook
docs.answer: Reels on your Page are public. Nothing to pick.

docs.title: X
docs.answer: Everyone can reply. Used once X is set up.

docs.title: Money
docs.answer: How close you are to getting paid, and real money each app reports.

docs.title: Money dashboard
docs.answer: The money each app reported, and what each clip earned.

docs.title: Your country
docs.answer: Some apps have different goals in each country. Pick yours once.

docs.title: YouTube
docs.answer: How close you are to the Partner Program, and what YouTube says you earned.

docs.title: TikTok
docs.answer: How close you are to Creator Rewards.

docs.title: Instagram
docs.answer: Followers against the goal for Gifts.

docs.title: Facebook
docs.answer: Followers, minutes watched and Meta's estimate once it is checked.

docs.title: X
docs.answer: Premium and verified followers against the goal.

docs.title: Getting your money out
docs.answer: Each app pays you itself. Add your bank or PayPal inside each app.

docs.title: Look & feel
docs.answer: Sounds, motion and your background. It has Sounds, Motion, Background.

docs.title: Sounds
docs.answer: Turn sounds on or off, and pick your two sounds.

docs.title: Sounds
docs.answer: Sounds only play when you tap, never when you scroll.

docs.title: Click sound
docs.answer: Plays when you tap something that works.

docs.title: Error sound
docs.answer: Plays when something can't be done.

docs.title: Try it
docs.answer: Hear your two sounds on a pretend Sign in button.

docs.title: Motion
docs.answer: Less moving around on the screen.

docs.title: Reduce motion
docs.answer: Turns off confetti, page moves and the moving background.

docs.title: Background
docs.answer: See-through glass, your picture or your colours.

docs.title: What's behind the glass
docs.answer: Pick See-through, Picture or Colours.

docs.title: Glass strength
docs.answer: Clear shows more of what's behind. Frosted shows less.

docs.title: Background picture
docs.answer: Use your own picture behind the glass. It stays on this device.

docs.title: Background colours
docs.answer: Mix up to 3 colours behind the glass.

docs.title: App & account
docs.answer: The app, updates, and your account. It has Get the app, Notifications, Updates, Ask, Account.

docs.where: Settings › App & account › Get the app
docs.title: Get the app
docs.answer: Open Clip Factory like any other app.

docs.where: Settings › App & account › Get the app
docs.title: Get the app
docs.answer: Put Clip Factory on this device, next to your other apps.

docs.title: Notifications
docs.answer: Get told when your clips are ready, even with the app closed.

docs.title: This device
docs.answer: Turn notifications on here. On iPhone, open Clip Factory from your Home Screen first.

docs.title: Clips ready
docs.answer: When your clips are done.

docs.title: It stopped
docs.answer: When a video stops and needs Try again.

docs.title: Picked up again
docs.answer: When a video that stopped starts again by itself.

docs.title: Every step
docs.answer: One card per video that changes as it works: the step and the clip. It can buzz often.

docs.title: Number on the app icon
docs.answer: Shows how many videos are working right now.

docs.title: Lock Screen widget
